title: Fix: sanitize tab/CR/LF in extract_overview() fields (CRITICAL)
description:
What: Tab characters in Subject/From fields corrupt OVER tab-separated output, breaking all newsreader clients. Fix extract_overview() in overview.rs.
Algorithm:
1. In crates/reader/src/store/overview.rs, add helper:
   fn sanitize_overview_field(s: &str) -> String {
       s.chars().map(|c| if c == '\t' || c == '\r' || c == '\n' { ' ' } else { c }).collect()
   }
2. In extract_overview(), wrap every string field assignment through sanitize_overview_field():
   subject, from, date, message_id, references
3. :bytes and :lines are numeric — no sanitization needed
4. Add test: article with Subject containing a tab → sanitized to space in OverviewRecord
Defensive: never store raw tab/CR/LF in overview SQLite; validate at extraction boundary.
Acceptance: test extract_overview_strips_tab_in_subject passes; cargo test -p usenet-ipfs-reader clean.
